body_bounds_scope: all body primitives before same-skin dao
anchor_nodes_role: bind/source anchors; SDK dynamic markers require joint-pose support

finger_rotation_calibration.application: normalize(q @ (Qx(x_degrees) @ Qz(z_degrees))) in local joint space

policy.method: one constant prepared +Y BoneRoot translation from target idle at source zero
policy.region: body vertices with total same-side Foot/Toe skin weight greater than 0.5
policy.scope: idle, walk and three attacks share one target guard shift; no per-frame grounding or IK
policy.residual_policy: measure keys and midpoints without modifying authored relative foot heights

private_v4_validation.root_shift_method: native canonical_grounding_clips actual timelines, target idle-derived once

retarget_record.method: world-space bind-rotation delta, target local bone lengths preserved
